description: Protected areas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by Offgrid Market Opportunities. A dataset of Protected Areas in Africa, containing a sub-set of areas from the WDPA dataset: - only areas pertaining to Sub-Saharan Africa - no Marine Proteced Areas - only Designated areas, no proposed areas. IUCN and UNEP-WCMC 2016, The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA), June 2016, Cambridge, UK: UNEP-WCMC. Available at: www.protectedplanet.net. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is restricted or on request according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is other closed licence (terms not stated in the catalogue entry). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
